title: Gut Microbiome Analysis in Mice
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ykjfuun

steps.title: Prepare Mice for Collection
steps.instruction: House mice singly in clean cages with fresh food, water, and low bedding.

steps.title: Record Initial Weights
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and record the initial amount of rodent diet provided ("food-in") in grams.

steps.title: Archive Diet Samples
steps.instruction: Save several pellets of rodent diet for energy or macronutrient analysis and store them at 4ºC in an airtight container.

steps.title: Monitor Food Intake
steps.instruction: Perform periodic weighing of the mouse and the remaining rodent diet ("food-out") in grams.

substeps.instruction: Weigh mouse and food-out at the end of the 48h collection period.

steps.title: Collect Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Collect all feces from the cage bottoms using tweezers.

substeps.instruction: Carefully inspect and remove each piece of bedding.
Inspect each fecal pellet to ensure no spilled food, hair, or bedding is attached.
If significant food spillage is found in the cage bottom, weigh it in a pre-tared weigh boat to add back to food measurements.

steps.title: Process and Weigh Feces
steps.instruction: Determine the fecal "wet" weight using pre-weighed tubes.

substeps.instruction: Place feces in a labeled pre-weighed 1.5 ml tube.
Subtract the original tube weight from the final weight to determine the wet weight.

steps.title: Post-Collection Animal Care
steps.instruction: Return animals to the housing system after cleaning.

substeps.instruction: Swap out cage bottoms with new clean bottoms.
Replace feeder insert and water bottle.

steps.title: Store and Ship Samples
steps.instruction: Preserve fecal samples and transport them for 16S DNA amplicon sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Store fecal samples at -80ºC until analysis.
Ship samples on dry ice to the UC Davis MBP (Mouse Biology Program, C/O UC Davis MMPC, 2795 Second Street, Suite 400, Davis, CA 95618).
Include the MBP/MMPC project # in the reference section of package documentation.
Send the FedEx/UPS tracking number to mmpc-bodyc@ucdavis.edu.
